# Code Anchors: Report-Free Shared Layer

- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/platform.ts` — the outcome type every platform call now returns, success value or failure text, printing nothing itself.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/projects.ts` — the project lookups generalised the same way: a found project, a not-found answer, or the named step that could not run, plus the organization-then-user scope fallback that only advances past a refusal or a non-scope-shaped answer.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/writeback.ts` — the settings write-back, its own seeded-configuration line moved to the caller now that this layer prints nothing.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/shared-module.spec.ts` — extended to cover the epic-only capabilities reached through this layer, holding the one-place rule structurally.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/platform.ts` — the second caller: reuses the outcome-returning platform calls and renders every line in its own vocabulary and stream.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/projects.ts` — the second caller's project planning, built on the same outcome-returning lookups.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/run.ts` — where each returned outcome is turned into a line, in the epic filer's own wording rather than the story filer's.
